title: IT Services — business IT support, endpoints, infrastructure and deployment
description: IT Services from ThatDeveloperGuy LLC: support desk, workstations and endpoints, network and infrastructure, deployment and maintenance.
heading: IT Services
summary: Support today, a brighter tomorrow: the systems your people use every day, kept running.

sections.heading: System status
sections.body: The status board in the room is an illustration, not live telemetry. Real monitoring is scoped per client and reported through agreed channels.

sections.heading: IT support
sections.body: A service desk with a named person behind it. Requests are tracked from first contact to closure.

sections.heading: Workstations and endpoints
sections.body: Laptops, desktops and the accounts on them: provisioning, updates, replacement and retirement.

sections.heading: Network and infrastructure
sections.body: Racks, switches, servers and the cloud services that replaced some of them — designed, documented and maintained.

sections.heading: Deployment and maintenance
sections.body: Planned rollouts with a tested rollback, and maintenance windows that are announced before they happen.

sections.heading: IT service process
sections.body: Plan, configure, deploy, maintain, improve — the five drawers of the tool cart, in that order.
